payload.claim: `candidate.path` (and `refusal.path` at line 282) is a path inside the `tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()` scratch export (`Path(scratch) / "at-base" / ".saffron" / "specs" / ...`), and `_print_queue` is called after the `with` block that owns `scratch` has already exited and deleted the directory. The path printed to the operator therefore never exists at the moment it is shown and does not correspond to any location in the target repo (e.g. `.saffron/specs/SY-1.md`) that the operator could actually open. `saffron queue`'s stated purpose is to let an operator check tonight's queue before trusting a night to it, and the location field of that queue is silently wrong for every candidate and refusal on every invocation. The new tests only assert on spec ids and count strings (`"SY-1" in out`, `"queue: 1 candidate(s)"`), never on the printed path value, so this is satisfied in letter (a path is printed) but not in behaviour (the path is a dangling reference to a directory removed before the print runs).
